acceptanceCriteria: receive_messages, receive_message_chain, jest.fn() assigned onto objects and jest.mock module factories are read as stubs.
On-path reachability follows resolvable first-party imports/requires to a bounded depth; unresolved hops keep the trace incomplete (no finding).
Fixture tests for each shape and one cross-module case.
body: Residual from V1-1887 (PR #1184 build log). Tracing stays inside one example, so stubs reached through imports are never on-path; several stub shapes are ignored and give no finding.
title: STUB-ON-PATH: cross-module reachability and unread stub shapes (receive_messages, receive_message_chain, jest.fn() assignments, jest.mock factories)
